g.text: One real day, five channels: the trace resolves ordinary occupancy and daylight

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f4e4a

g.text: SCD-30 (CO₂ / temperature / humidity) and two Grove analog channels, 288 samples at a 5-minute interval,

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f4e4a

g.text: 288/288 complete. The shaded column is the morning occupancy window; dashed lines are the WELL v2

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f4e4a

g.text: reference thresholds, and the right-hand strip gives each channel's range and mean (Table 6).

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86847e

g.text: checked against a reference meter. n = 1 day, 1 room, 1 deployment.

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86847e

g.text: mapped to lux and dBA by a fixed per-channel calibration during ingestion — disclosed in Table 6, and not cross-

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86847e

g.text: operating range; nothing here was introduced to create an event. The Grove light and sound columns are ADC readings

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86847e

g.text: Source: Essay/documents/real-trace-2026-07-10-london.csv. Every channel stays within its expected physical
